rows.grounds: Compound expressing purpose: purification (viśuddhi) of the five elements (pañca-tattva).
Refers to the five Brahman mantras; object of chanting.
Present active participle indicating the act of muttering or reciting mantras.

items.question: What ritual recitation accomplishes the purification of the five fundamental elements?
premises: Prior internal purification has already been performed.
Purification of the five elements is the intended aim.
The five Brahman mantras are designated for recitation.
items.inference: Chanting the five Brahman mantras accomplishes the purification of the five elements.
uncertainties: manūn is taken as mantras or sacred formulas associated with the five Brahmans.
items.plain_english: For the purification of the five elements, one should chant the five Brahman mantras.
